runtimeEvidence.summary: The exact committed audit tools completed under the production systemd EnvironmentFile with statement_timeout=15000ms, lock_timeout=1000ms and batch_size=500. Command execution passed while the audited product state correctly remained blocked.

Pointer before and after were identical at generation 24, active Manifest 6517fc25 and rollback Manifest 18c42522; Gear Release de407938, dependency-vector hash b3f5b06e and release-event hash 661d2e74 were stable.

The fixed audit store executed 12 statements with 9 reads, 3 transaction controls and 0 writes. The 40-specialization reader executed 282 reads, 81 transaction controls and 0 writes. All connections were session/read-transaction read-only.

The active release mapped 1312/1488 items and 356/46631 raw variants; 63/63 options mapped. Missing slot, rank, item-level and static-stat facts plus ambiguous highest ranks block lossless CatalogRevision mapping.

The active Manifest exposes no Community Release and zero active community templates. Exactly 40 specialization rows were read, but all 40 had zero initial candidates and none counted as verified coverage.

Relation, active/rollback materialization and filesystem bytes were measured; historical peak RSS and temporary bytes remain unknown. Static inventory found 166 runtime calls and five unresolved references across three operational scripts.

Both before and after the audit, /api/data/health reported overallStatus=partial. Verified components were backend, data_health_followup, active_manifest, gear_stat_snapshot, attribute_rule_audit, raiderio and websim_season; gear_release_refresh, news, websim_sync, gear_legality_authority and season_cutover_readiness were blocked; gear_catalog, talent_catalog, template_simc_bridge, community_templates, stat_weights and wcl_credentials were partial; blizzard_api was pending_official_audit.

wow-backend retained the same PID, ActiveEnterTimestamp and NRestarts=0. Nine existing wow timers remained active/enabled; wow-gear-release-refresh.timer remained inactive/disabled. No timer, backfill, sync, release builder, stat job or SimC task was started by Phase 0.

risks.detail: Active item and variant rows do not yet satisfy the approved CatalogRevision and BrowseVariant identity contract.
The active Manifest has no Community Release, so no active community template can be audited or imported through the initial 40-spec reader.
Measured relation/materialization/disk values are usable, but peak builder RSS and temporary disk remain unknown because Phase 0 did not run an unsafe full builder.
Five references in three operational scripts remain unresolved and prevent schema shadow or compatibility retirement.

cleanup.reason: All transient systemd units were collected and the isolated /tmp audit directory was removed. The active runtime tree was never modified.
